text:
The Super Eagles of Nigeria has confirmed that Ademola Lookman will miss the upcoming Africa Cup of Nations qualifier against Tanzania in Zanzibar.
Promise Efoghe, the team’s media officer, confirmed Lookman’s injury status to media on Saturday, three days to the reverse encounter.
Lookman was injured in the 43rd minute of the first encounter between both nations, with Nigeria claiming a hard-fought 3-1 win. The Atletico Madrid attacker had provided the assist for Nigeria’s second-minute opener before succumbing to the injury with the match deadlocked at 1-1.
He was replaced by Moses Simon in first half added time despite on-field treatment at the Godswill Akpabio stadium in Uyo.
Efoghe revealed that Lookman had suffered a sprained knee ligament confirmed by scan after the match. The sprain therefore ruled out Lookman who has suffered a dip in form for club and country in recent months.
It was, however, not confirmed if Lookman will join the team to Zanzibar to cheer on from the sidelines, or return to Atletico Madrid to begin his recovery.
Lookman has just two goal contributions (1 goal, 1 assist) for club and country since the start of the new season, and his assist for Alhassan Yusuf for Nigeria’s opener in Uyo was his first goals contribution in national team colours in four matches.
The former CAF Africa Player of the Year winner has 11 goals contributions in 46 caps for Nigeria since his 2022 debut.
